atoms.text: Killer whales are fierce predators that have been seen in oceans all over the world. However, they prefer cooler waters like in the Pacific Northwest and Alaska. Killer whales are carnivores and like to eat fish, seals, sea lions and penguins. An interesting fact is that although they have 'whale' in their name, killer whales are in fact the largest type of dolphin. An adult killer whale can grow to be between 5.5 and 9.8 metres long; almost the length of a bus. Killer whales are very social animals and like to live in groups, which are called pods. There can be up to 40 killer whales in one pod. Killer whales can also live a long time. Some killer whales live to be 80 years old.
